periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: The primary axis of the black eye patches is oriented at approximately a 45-degree angle, slanting downwards towards the rostrum relative to the horizontal facial plane.

periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: There is a pronounced downward tapering effect where the lower margin of the patch extends further from the geometric center than the upper margin.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The dark band is thick and robust, occupying approximately one-third of the visible vertical height of the upper torso at the lateral flanks.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced brownish-yellow staining is visible on the fur surrounding the oral cavity and extending down the medial surface of the lower abdomen and inner thighs.
